description:
Cutover UAT for `PLATFORM=datafusion BENCHMARK=joinorder SCALE=1`
failed 113/113 queries before execution because the DataFusion adapter
registered canonical Parquet tables with synthetic `f0` column names.

Evidence:
  /Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/uat_joinorder_cutover/datafusion_joinorder_1.0_20260511_135128.log

The immediate failure signature is:
  Schema error: No field named <alias>.<column>. Valid fields are <alias>.f0 ...

Revalidation on current `develop` (fa1df7359) with DataFusion 53.0.0 showed
this failure is no longer present with the current verified canonical
JoinOrder Parquet cache. No adapter code change was required in this TODO.
